record.title: National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence
record.summary: Discussion paper in which NITI Aayog sets out a national strategy for AI under the theme #AIforAll. It covers research, skilling, adoption in healthcare, agriculture, education, smart cities and mobility, and a chapter on ethics, privacy, security and AI. The chapter urges fairness and bias mitigation, data protection and sectoral regulation, privacy-preserving techniques, and a liability framework with a negligence test and safe harbours for developers.
record.notes: Described by NITI Aayog as a discussion paper, released in June 2018 on the mandate given in the 2018-2019 Budget Speech. NITI Aayog later published approach papers detailing its recommendations, for example AIRAWAT on AI-specific cloud computing infrastructure. The stored PDF is the copy on the NITI Aayog site uploaded in March 2023.

judgment.status_reasoning: A discussion paper released in June 2018; NITI Aayog's later approach papers build on it and no withdrawal or replacement appears in the stored sources. The NITI Aayog site still hosts it. India's later AI governance guidelines (IN-02) are a separate instrument.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Adoption-focused national strategy whose main content is not safety, with a chapter on ethics, privacy and security and a proposed liability framework; borderline, included with a scope note.

open_questions: The PDF carries no date of its own; the month comes from NITI Aayog's AIRAWAT approach paper, so the date is given to the month.
